name: Tarrel Rockweaver
summary: At Menethil Harbor’s bridge, Tarrel Rockweaver anxiously waits for news of his wife, Merrin. The dwarf fears for her safety after she joined an inland archaeological expedition.

sections.title: A Watch on the Bridge
sections.body: Tarrel Rockweaver watches the bridge at Menethil Harbor, where trade and military shipments pass. His wife, Merrin Rockweaver, joined Prospector Whelgar’s prestigious archaeological expedition deeper in the Wetlands. Violent raptors overran the excavation site and cut off regular communication. Stranded in town, Tarrel begs travelers to scout east toward Whelgar’s Excavation Site and learn whether Merrin survived.

faq.answer: Tarrel is an Ironforge dwarf waiting desperately near the entrance bridge of Menethil Harbor. He hopes for word of his wife, Merrin, who left on an inland dig.

faq.q: Why is Tarrel asking travelers for help?
aliases: in search of the excavation team
faq.answer: Tarrel lost contact with Merrin after danger struck her archaeological team at the dig site. Unable to leave his post, he asks travelers to head east toward Whelgar’s Excavation Site and find her.

Merrin Rockweaver is Tarrel’s wife and an archaeologist with Prospector Whelgar’s excavation team. She survived an attack on their camp and took shelter with the other survivors in a cave overlooking the dig site.

Merrin traveled east into the Wetlands to study ancient titan and dwarven relics. After the main dig site was attacked, she and the surviving excavators took shelter in a cave overlooking the ruined dig.

angles.text: Tarrel’s worry shows the perilous cost of the Explorer’s League’s relentless drive to uncover dwarven origins across the wild frontiers of Khaz Modan.
For travelers arriving at Menethil’s port, Tarrel offers a close look at the hardships facing Alliance citizens stationed along the untamed marshes.
